sloka: मन्ये न तावदात्मानं बुद्ध्यते वानराधिपः।शैलप्रहाराभिहतः कुम्भकर्णेन संयुगे ।। ६.६७.७८ ।।
transliteration: manye na tāvadātmānaṁ buddhyate vānarādhipaḥ।śailaprahārābhihataḥ kumbhakarṇena saṁyuge ।। 6.67.78 ।।

translations.english: 'Or else this Sugriva alone can get liberated by fighting by himself with gods, demons and Nagas also, even if he is captured'.
